metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: Authentication — Failed Login Then Success (Password Compromise)
properties.description: Detects failed login followed by success from same source indicating potential password compromise
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'auth' | extend auth_result = iff(EventID == 4624, 'success', 'failure') | summarize FailureCount=countif(auth_result=='failure'), SuccessCount=countif(auth_result=='success') by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m), resource_group, SourceIP, TargetUserName | where FailureCount > 3 and SuccessCount > 0
